## Description

Please include a summary of the change and the related issue. 

- Fixes # (issue)
- Structural impact (e.g. affect on Lyapunov stability gate or uncertainty calibration)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the PEP-8 style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (like README or APIs)
- [ ] My changes generate no new lint or compile errors
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have run the benchmarks suite and verified no stability degradation
